claim_text: Plant-based diets may contain phytate, which can reduce zinc bioavailability, but vegan status alone does not establish zinc deficiency or a need for zinc gluconate supplementation.
health_goal_or_outcome: Support safe, indication-specific recommendations and avoid unsupported supplementation.
ingredient_form_or_preparation: Relevant dietary and supplemental forms; verify exact product label and formulation.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Zinc fact sheet describes phytate effects and zinc bioavailability.
limitations: No dose from diet label alone; assess total elemental zinc and dietary pattern.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
